Looking at the cuboid (3 wide × 3 high × 2 deep), the visible white faces are at: front-left-middle, top-back-left, and right-middle-back.

**Deducing the hidden cubes:**
- The grey piece must be the six visible grey cubes (front middle column, front top/bottom left, top back middle).
- The dark piece must be the five visible dark cubes plus the hidden bottom-back-middle cube (to stay connected).
- That leaves the white piece: the three visible white cubes plus hidden cubes (1,1,2), (1,2,2), (2,2,2) in coordinates (x,y,z).

**White piece shape:** center cube with arms: up (1), down (1), front (1), and right (2) — i.e., a flat T of four cubes (bar of 3 plus one stem) with a tail of two cubes hanging perpendicular from the center of the bar.

Rotating this shape (90° about the front-back axis) gives exactly a horizontal T of four cubes with a column of two cubes below the center — which is diagram A.

\boxed{A}
